name: Body shaving / hair removal for skin texture
lead: Body shaving and hair removal, in this context, means removing chest, arm, leg or back hair to make skin look smoother or to show muscle definition. It is discussed in appearance communities as a style practice rather than a medical treatment. Men most often shave facial hair, and some also shave the chest, abdomen, underarms, legs or pubic area [2].

Published research on cosmetic body shaving is limited. One well-known investigation described an outbreak of MRSA skin infections among players on a college football team in which cosmetic body shaving and turf burns were identified as facilitating factors [1].
infobox: Cuts, razor burn, razor bumps, ingrown hairs

paras: Methods include wet shaving with a straight or safety razor, electric shaving and trimmers [2]. Wikipedia notes shaving history from copper razors around 3000 BC to disposable razors popularized after 1974 [2].

Reported effects include cuts, razor burn, razor bumps (pseudofolliculitis barbae) and ingrown hairs [2]. Wikipedia states that shaving does not cause terminal hair to grow back thicker, coarser or darker, and attributes the impression to the blunt tip of cut hair [2].

No studies found on body shaving specifically for skin texture. A retrospective cohort study of a 2003 college football team investigated an MRSA outbreak of cellulitis and abscesses among 100 players and linked cosmetic body shaving and turf burns to its spread [1].

refs.title: A high-morbidity outbreak of methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus among players on a college football team, facilitated by cosmetic body shaving and turf burns

card.summary: Shaving or removing body hair to look smoother; a grooming choice with minor skin irritation risks and little dedicated research.
card.note: Reported effects include razor burn, bumps and ingrown hairs; one MRSA outbreak report cites cosmetic shaving.

quick.overview:
Body shaving is hair removal on the torso or limbs for a smoother or more defined look. It is a style practice, not a treatment.

Little research addresses it for skin texture specifically.
quick.mechanism: Razors or trimmers cut hair at the skin surface; hair removal is temporary.
quick.risks: Cuts, razor burn, razor bumps and ingrown hairs are reported; an MRSA outbreak in a football team was linked in part to cosmetic body shaving.
